# Campus Counsel

> Maharashtra's trusted engineering admission and career guidance platform helping students with MHT-CET, JEE, CAP Rounds, engineering college selection, and career planning.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Campus Counsel services, mentorship ecosystem, packages, FAQs, and contact options.

## Optional

- [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/campus_counsel_/): Updates, student stories, and admission tips.
- [WhatsApp Group](https://chat.whatsapp.com/ENVFwpeZDHy5vXApbukiWl): Community group for aspirants.
